claims.text: DFT+DMFT can reliably predict and capture ferromagnetic ground states in strongly correlated transition-metal compounds.
DFT+DMFT captures ferromagnetic ground states by properly accounting for spin polarization.
DFT+DMFT captures ferromagnetic ground states by properly accounting for many-body exchange-correlation effects.
Local electron-exchange interactions and spin polarization on transition-metal ions mediate magnetic ordering.
DFT+DMFT treats dynamical electron correlations more accurately than standard DFT.
DFT+DMFT treats spin effects more accurately than standard DFT.
Improved treatment of dynamical correlations and spin effects captures the energetic balance required for ferromagnetic ordering.
For the proposed material, DFT+DMFT will predict a lower total energy for the ferromagnetic configuration than for competing magnetic states.
The DFT+DMFT prediction will agree with experimental indicators of ferromagnetism.
Standard DFT may inadequately capture many-body effects relevant to the magnetic ground state.
Standard DFT may inadequately capture spin-polarization effects and consequently predict an incorrect magnetic ground state.
The accuracy of DFT+DMFT magnetic predictions may depend on the chosen Hubbard U and other model parameters.
Materials with extremely strong correlations or additional many-body interactions may require parameter recalibration.
DFT+DMFT is expected to improve magnetic-ground-state predictions relative to standard DFT.
